text: Install a project checkout into FontLab from its install.vfpy . A project's install.vfpy needs two lines:: import fontlab_instamix.bootstrap as b b.install_project(__file__) It reads [tool.fontlab-install] from the project's pyproject.toml (keys: id , name , packages , scripts , extensions , dependencies , init-script ) and turns it into a .fontlabext installed by :mod: fontlab_instamix.extension , so the ledger and uninstall are shared.
